posteriorPredictive.interpretation: approximately 95% of posterior-predictive coverage worlds meet 0.98 under the fitted model and evidence
posteriorPredictive.doesNotPromise: absence of rare consequential realized evidence errors

realizedTailRisk.coverageSource: independently scored criterion audit under the approved sampling estimator

severeMissRate.developmentReferenceRole: illustrative continuation of the existing two-percentage-point development materiality boundary; not a release gate

conditionalSevereExpectedShortfall.zeroSevereEventConvention: not estimable; report event support and the frequency upper bound

worstObservedShortfall.reason: sample-size dependent and not a standalone probability claim

humanEstimationContract.weights: use approved item inclusion probabilities for the criterion-audit estimand
humanEstimationContract.zeroObservedSevereMisses: never report as zero risk; report a one-sided upper uncertainty bound under the approved method

evidenceRoles.syntheticDevelopment: mechanism diagnosis and candidate-specific screens only
evidenceRoles.developmentConfirmation: one-time evaluation after candidate and numerical decision fields are frozen
evidenceRoles.releaseHoldout: last synthetic release gate after development-confirmation progression
evidenceRoles.realLearnerHoldout: required source for human severe-tail frequency/severity claims
evidenceRoles.priorZeroMaterialTailRules: candidate-specific development rules; not retrospective release semantics

unblockRule: An authorized statistical/release review must fill every applicable releaseDecisionFields value before another safeguard receives an acceptance run or the development-confirmation reservation is bound.
